Maya: Quick sync — collecting postmortem follow-ups for last night's route-flap that caused cross-region retries. I want a short list of owners, deadlines, and any monitoring changes needed.

Kevin: Short root-cause recap: a recent BGP path-preference tweak + an ingress controller SNI fallback behavior exposed a routing asymmetry. Traffic from eu-west sporadically preferred a suboptimal path, triggering TCP/TLS handshake restarts -> retries at the LB layer.

Maya: TL;DR => routing preference change exposed an SNI mismatch in the ingress fallback. That produced bursts of 502/524 and retry storms across regions.

Kevin: Evidence: logs show repeated TLS ClientHello -> server reset after 120-300ms. Sample: ```
[ingress-proxy] 2026-07-03T01:12:45Z TLS handshake error: SNI mismatch for host "api.redwood" -> connection closed
[lb] 2026-07-03T01:12:46Z upstream reset, retry count=3
```

Luca: Action 1 (owner: Luca) — revert BGP preference change in eu-west and validate route convergence tools. ETA 2026-07-04 EOD. I'll run the staged rollback and post runbook steps here. @Kevin can you add the specific AS path we should pin to?

Kevin: Added AS path list to the ticket. Also: Action 2 (owner: Anika) — audit ingress controller SNI fallback: ensure it never falls back to wildcard virtual host on mismatched SNI. Proposed fix: explicit reject + 421 response to avoid retries. ETA 2026-07-06.

Anika: Confirmed. I'll open a PR to the ingress-config and add a unit test that simulates bad SNI. Plan: canary rollout to eu-west only for the config change, monitor for 6 hours.

Maya: Action 3 (owner: Maya) — add a synthetic probe that exercises cross-region TLS handshakes every 5m and alerts on handshake reset rate > 0.5% for 15m. ETA 2026-07-05. This should help catch recurrence quickly.

Kevin: Action 4 (owner: SRE) — tune LB retry policy: reduce automatic client-side retries for upstream 5xx within 10s of route-change window. Create a short-lived flag to disable retries for 1h after major routing changes. ETA 2026-07-05.

sre-bot: Ticket created: INC-5123 (route-flap -> tls-retry-storm). Linked: https://tickets.redwood/INC-5123.

Luca: Notes from validation run: after revert, qcap shows path convergence in ~18s and no handshake resets in sample window. I'll post the trace links.

Anika: PR opened: https://git.redwood/ingress/merge_requests/889 — includes test matrix. Requesting review from @Kevin and @Maya.

Maya: Monitoring changes: I added the probe (probe-id: cross-region-tls-1) and a grafana panel to the network dashboard. Alert rule: rule ID net.tls.handshake_regress -> page if >0.5% for 15m.

Kevin: Follow-up tasks (short):
- update runbook with detection steps and mitigation commands (owner Kevin) ETA 2026-07-05
- schedule a 30m postmortem sync next Tue to review long-term fixes (owner Maya) ETA meeting invite by EOD
- confirm that captains oncall know to disable LB retries during major route changes (owner Luca) ETA 2026-07-05

Maya: Recurrence patterns: this looks like the same symptom class as the March routing jitter incidents — whenever we change path preference + ingress fallback mismatch, retries spike. Proposal: add a pre-change checklist to require ingress config compatibility test before any BGP preference change.

Luca: Agreed. I will add the pre-change checklist item to the network change template.

Anika: Also adding an automated SNI integration test into the CI pipeline so any fallback regressions fail the build. ETA 2026-07-12.

Kevin: Risk/constraints: we need to be careful with rollouts — disabling retries can increase tail latency for clients that depend on retries. We'll keep the flag opt-in for 24h and monitor.

Maya: Ok final checklist from this thread: 
- [ ] INC-5123 tracked and prioritized (sre-bot)
- [ ] revert BGP pref (Luca) - ETA 7/04
- [ ] ingress SNI reject patch + tests (Anika) - ETA 7/06
- [ ] add synthetic cross-region TLS probe (Maya) - ETA 7/05
- [ ] LB retry short-circuit flag + runbook update (Kevin) - ETA 7/05
- [ ] pre-change checklist added to network change template (Luca) - ETA 7/08
- [ ] CI SNI integration test (Anika) - ETA 7/12

Maya: Please update the ticket INC-5123 with notes as you complete items. I'll close this thread once all items are owned and dated. Thanks :white_check_mark:

Kevin: Thanks all. Will post postmortem link when ready.

Luca: Will ping when revert is done and attach packet captures.

Anika: Starting the PR review now.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync on 2026-07-07 15:00 UTC for owners mentioned in INC-5123.
